verdict.rationale: Bun documents a global install cache whose path can be redirected with `BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR`, which makes it cacheable in CI. It also documents a no-network install mode in which an uncached dependency is an error, plus `--frozen-lockfile` for reproducible CI installs and a claimed speedup of up to 25x over npm. missing for 10: an explicit CI cache-restore recipe (e.g. a CI cache key/restore example), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI install speed and offline behavior.
